mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of UNRATE >5.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of HOUST and RSAFS decline instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a quarterly GDP growth decline (GDPC1) signals imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as earnings forecasts revise downward.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of GDPC1 <2.0% instances during late-cycle, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of PAYEMS increase periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals supply contraction with monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO decline and FEDFUNDS rise instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% signals restrictive policy that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS >2.0% periods during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
